ValidationRule.description: Status can't be changed once closed the opportunity
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Stage__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Stage__c ), 'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Stage__c ), 'Closed Lost') ), $Profile.Name <> 'System Admin' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once the stage is Closed Won / Lost, You cannot change the status!!!
